βρώσιμος, -ον 
 (βρῶσις), [in LXX: Lev.19:23, Neh.9:25, Eze.47:12 (מַאֲכָל)* ;] 
eatable: Luk.24:41.†
 (AS)

γογγυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ, 
 [in LXX: Isa.58:9 (אָוֶן), Exo.16:7-9, Num.17:5, 10 (תְּלוּנָה), Wis.1:10, 11 Sir.46:7 * ;] 
a murmuring, muttering: Jhn.7:12, Act.6:1; ἄνευ γ., 1Pe.4:9; pl., χωρὶς γ., Php.2:14.†
 (AS)

ἔκ-γονος, -ον
 (ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;] 
__1. with genitive, born of. 
 __2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Ti.5:4.†
 (AS)

ἐκ-πνέω, -ῶ, 
 to breathe out; sc. βίον, ψυχήν (expressed in cl., Æsch., al.; cf. LS, see word), to breathe one's last, expire: Mrk.15:37, 39 Luk.23:46. For force of aorist, see Swete, Mrk.15:37.†
 (AS)

ἀγαλλιάω, -ῶ, Hellenistic form of cl. ἀγάλλω, to glorify, mid. -ομαι, to exult in; 
 [in LXX (most frequently in Pss.) chiefly for גיל, רנן pi. ;] 
to exult, rejoice greatly: before ἐπί, with dative, Luk.1:47; with dative mod., 1Pe.1:8, Rev.19:7. Mid., with same sense: Mat.5:12, Luk.10:21, Act.2:26, 16:34, 1Pe.4:13; before ἵνα, Jhn.8:56; ἐν, Jhn.5:35 (1 aor. pass. perh. as mid.; but see Mozley, Psalter, 5), 1Pe.1:6 (Cremer, 590).†
 (AS)

εὐλαβής, -ές
 (εὖ, λαβεῖν), [in LXX: Mic.7:2 AB2 (חָסִיד); εὐ. ποιεῖν, Lev.15:31 (נָזַר hi.), Sir.11:7 א2* ;] 
__1. cautious, circumspect. 
 __2. devout, religious, reverent: Act.2:5 8:2 22:12; δίκαιος καὶ εὐ., Luk.2:25.†
 (AS)

κατα-μανθάνω 
 [in LXX: Gen.34:1 (רָאָה), Job.35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;] 
to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Mat.6:28.†
 (AS)

κύκλος, -ου, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;] 
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., round about, around: Mrk.3:34 6:6, 36, Luk.9:12, Rom.15:19; with genitive, Rev.4:6 5:11 7:11†
 (AS)

μακάριος, -α, -ον
 (collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), [in LXX for אֹשֶׁר ;] 
blessed, happy (DCG, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), 1Ti.1:11 6:15; ἐλπίς, Tit.2:13; esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, Pr., 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, Mat.5:3 ff., Luk.6:20 ff. Jhn.20:29, Rev.1:3, al.; before ptcp., Luk.1:45, al.; ὅς, Mat.11:6, Luk.7:23, Rom.4:7-8; ὅτι, Mat.13:16, al.; ἐάν, Jhn.13:17, 1Co.7:40; compar., μ. . . . μᾶλλον, Act.20:35; -ώτερος, 1Co.7:40 
 SYN.: εὐλογητός, q.v (AS)

Μακεδονία, -ας, ἡ 
 Macedonia: Act.16:9-10, 1Co.16:5, 2Co.1:16, Php.4:15, al.; M. καὶ Ἀχαία, Act.19:21, Rom.15:26, 1Th.1:7-8 
 (AS)

ἀνα-δέχομαι 
 [in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;] 
__1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.11:17. 
 __2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Act.28:7.†
 (AS)

νῦν, adv., 
 [in LXX chiefly for עַתָּה ;] 
 __1. prop., of time, now, i.e. at the present time: as opposite to past, Jhn.4:18, Act.7:52, Rom.13:11, 2Co.7:9, Col.1:24, al.; opposite to fut., Jhn.12:27, Rom.11:31, al.; with art., ὁ (ἡ, τὸ) and subst., the present: Rom.3:26, Gal.4:25, 1Ti.6:17, Tit.2:12, al.; απὸ τοῦ ν. (LXX for מֵעַתָּה), Luk.1:48, Act.18:6, al.; ἄχρι τοῦ ν., Rom.8:22, Php.1:5; ἕως τοῦ ν. (LXX for עַד עַתָּה), Mat.24:21, Mrk.13:19; τὰ ν., as regards the present, Act.5:38; with pret., just now, but now, Mat.26:65, Jhn.11:8 21:10; with fut., now, presently, Jhn.12:31, Act.20:22; so with praes., presently, forthwith, Jhn.12:31 17:13; καὶ ν., Jhn.11:22 17:5, al.; ἀλλὰ ν., Luk.22:36; ἔτι ν., 1Co.3:2; τότε (πότε) . . . ν. (δέ), Rom.6:21 11:30; ν. ἤδη, 1Jn.4:3; ν. οὖν, Act.10:33, al. 
 __2. Of logical sequence (often difficult to disting. from the temporal sense; cf. Lft., Notes, 113f.), now, therefore, now, however, as it is: Luk.11:39; καὶ ν., Act.3:17, 2Th.2:6, 1Jn.2:28; id. before δεῦρο, Act.7:34; ν. δέ, Jhn.8:40 9:41 15:22, 24, 18:36, 1Co.5:11 7:14 12:20, al. (cf. WM, 579.11).
 (AS)

πέλαγος, -ους, τό 
 [in LXX: 2Ma.5:21, 4Ma.7:1 * ;] 
the deep sea, the deep, the sea: Act.27:5; τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, Mat.18:6 
 SYN.: θαλάσσα (which see); and cf. ἄβυσσος (AS)

περι-σπάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה ;] 
to draw around, draw off or away. Metaphorical, to distract: pass., Luk.10:40.†
 (AS)

σχοινίον, -ου, τό
 (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), 
[in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jhn.2:15, Act.27:32.†
 (AS)

ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr., 150), 
 talitha, i.e. maiden: Mrk.5:41.†
 (AS)

Τύρος, -ου, ἡ 
 Tyre, a maritime city of Phænicia: Mrk.7:31, Act.21:3, 7; Τ. κ, Σιδών, Mat.11:21-22 15:21, Mrk.3:8 7:24, Luk.6:17 10:13-14.†
 (AS)

ὑπερ-άνω 
 compound adv., [in LXX for עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;] 
above: as prep. with genitive, Eph.1:21 4:10, Heb.9:5.†
 (AS)

φιλόστοργος, -ον
 (στοργή, family affection), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:13 * ;] 
tenderly loving, affectionate (Xen., Plut., al.): of Christians, Rom.12:10.†
 (AS)

Χρύσεος, -εα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν; on accusative sing. fem., -ᾶν, Rev.1:13 and genitive pl. uncontr., -εων, Rev.2:1, LTr., see M, Pr., 48 and cf. Thackeray, Gr., x, 172 f.)
 (χρυσός), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] 
golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: 2Ti.2:20, Heb.9:4, Rev.1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15.†
 (AS)

χρυσό-πρασος, -ου, ὁ 
 a chrysoprase (see Swete, Ap., 289): Rev.21:20.†
 (AS)

ἆσσον (Rec., after Vg., Ἄσσον), 
 adv. (compar. of ἄγχι, near), 
nearer: Act.27:13 (RV, close in shore; see B1., § 11, 3; 44, 3; poets, Ion, and late prose).†
 (AS)

βάτραχος, -ου, ὁ, 
 [in LXX: Ex 8, Psa.77 (78):45 104 (105):30 (צְכַרִדֵּעַ), Wis.19:10 * ;] 
a frog: Rev.16:13.†
 (AS)

 § Baruch = "blessed"

4) son of Col-hozeh, a descendant of Perez or Pharez, the son of Judah
